summary: A vertical or horizontal line that visually separates adjacent content.

alternatives.when: Separating groups of MenuItem components within a submenu.
Separating groups of ActionPopoverItem components within an ActionPopover.

pitfalls: Divider is vertical by default; set type to horizontal for a full-width line between stacked content.
Divider adds spacing by default: horizontal dividers have mt and mb of 3 (24px), and vertical dividers have p of 3 (24px) on every side.

Only horizontal dividers have separator semantics, because they render an hr; vertical dividers are purely visual, and inside a Menu they render as list items that are always hidden from assistive technology.

examples.description: Separate groups of form fields with a horizontal divider and custom vertical margins.
Separate items in a flex row with vertical dividers given an explicit height.
Separate top-level items in a horizontal Menu with a vertical divider.
